name: Transkriptor
description:
Transkriptor connects Claude to your Transkriptor account so you can work with your transcriptions without leaving the chat.

With this connector you can:
- List and filter your transcripts by name, date, or duration
- Read full transcript text with timestamps and speaker labels
- Get AI-generated summaries of any transcription
- Export a transcript as a downloadable PDF
- Check your account details, remaining minutes, and subscription plan

Sign in with your Transkriptor account to get started. Claude will only access transcripts you already own, and all tools are read-only.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Transkriptor to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Transkriptor to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.transkriptor.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Transkriptor MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Transkriptor provides these MCP tools: transkriptor_export_pdf, transkriptor_get_summary, transkriptor_get_transcript, transkriptor_get_transcripts, and transkriptor_get_user_info.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Transkriptor?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Transkriptor in communication on the Manufact MCP catalog include AgentLine: Phone Numbers for AI Agents, JooVoice, OpenMail, Granola, and Fleet Connected Apps.
Transkriptor requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Transkriptor is developed by Tor App. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
